# DevKofi
> DevKofi is Kofi Arhin's founder-led creative technology studio for product strategy, UX/UI design, full-stack web development, and practical AI engineering.

## Main sections
- [Home](https://devkofi.com/): What DevKofi is, what the studio builds, and how product strategy, design, full-stack development, and AI engineering connect.
- [Work](https://devkofi.com/work): Selected digital products, case studies, experiments, technologies, and implementation evidence.
- [Services](https://devkofi.com/services): Product discovery, UX/UI design, full-stack web development, product evolution, automation, and AI-enabled feature work.
- [About](https://devkofi.com/about): Kofi Arhin's role, MERN-stack and AI engineering expertise, and DevKofi's founder-led working principles.
- [Lab](https://devkofi.com/lab): Reusable developer templates, starter systems, workflows, and product experiments from real engineering practice.
- [Journal](https://devkofi.com/journal): Upcoming field notes on AI engineering, full-stack development, product strategy, UX/UI, testing, and verification.
- [Start a Project](https://devkofi.com/start-a-project): Project enquiry route for web apps, full-stack MVPs, AI-enabled products, dashboards, landing experiences, automation, and redesigns.

## Key facts
- Founder: Kofi Arhin
- Studio: DevKofi
- Engineering focus: JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, APIs, AI integrations, automation, testing, and product delivery
